QuestInfo.name: Tristan's Pupil
QuestInfo.1: Ryden wants you to venture deep into Sleepywood and locate Tristan's apprentice, Mu Young. As someone else who's also lost his master, he might be able to shed light on things.
QuestInfo.2: You have ended your conversation with Tristan. Ask Mu Young for Tristan's Keepsake.

1.0: Pardon me, but you LITERALLY look like you've seen a ghost. My master's ghost always shows up uninvited. He keeps scaring everybody!
1.1: Oh, my master wants me to give you his Keepsake? Sure, one second. He must really like you.

npc.0: Go talk to Tristan's apprentice, Mu Young.

quest.0: Can you hear my master's voice? He shows up here all the time, even if he's a ghost. Your lightbulb icon seems to be picking up a strange voice.
